service: backend-proyectate
frameworkVersion: '4'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs22.x # <-- Actualizado a la versión más reciente para evitar la advertencia
  region: us-east-1
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:Scan
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:Query
          Resource: 
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:*:table/ReportesTabla"
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:${aws:region}:*:table/ReportesTabla/index/UbicacionIndex"

resources:
  Resources:
    ReportesTabla:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ReportesTabla
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: reporteId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: ubicacion_qr
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: reporteId
            KeyType: HASH
        GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
          - IndexName: UbicacionIndex
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: ubicacion_qr
                KeyType: HASH
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

functions:
  crearReporte:
    handler: handler.crearReporte
    events:
      - http:
          path: reportes
          method: post
          cors: true
          
  obtenerPinesAR:
    handler: handler.obtenerPinesAR
    events:
      - http:
          path: ubicaciones/{ubicacion_qr}/reportes # <-- CAMBIO CLAVE: Ruta independiente
          method: get
          cors: true

  resolverReporte:
    handler: handler.resolverReporte
    events:
      - http:
          path: reportes/{reporteId}/resolver
          method: put
          cors: true
